article.headline: Winthrop wins 84-71 over UNC Asheville
article.description: — Logan Duncomb scored 26 points as Winthrop beat UNC Asheville 84-71 on Saturday.
article.story: ROCK HILL, S.C. -- — Logan Duncomb scored 26 points as Winthrop beat UNC Asheville 84-71 on Saturday. Duncomb had 10 rebounds for the Eagles (16-8, 8-1 Big South Conference). Kody Clouet shot 6 of 8 from the field, including 4 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 3 from the line to add 19 points. Kareem Rozier went 5 of 12 from the field (5 for 11 from 3-point range) to finish with 17 points. The Eagles extended their winning streak to eight games. Kameron Taylor led the way for the Bulldogs (10-13, 4-5) with 25 points and two blocks. Justin Wright added 21 points for UNC Asheville. Toyaz Solomon also had 14 points, two steals and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
